notes: Translating the Stockopedia quality screens kept producing the same shape of failure: a chip that states one quantity against another, and a catalog that only carries the ratio somebody else already decided to take. Debt and earnings as LEVELS — totalDebtFy, longTermDebtFy, netIncomeFy, off the balance sheet and income statement the fund stage already fetches. Every debt instrument here was a ratio, and a ratio answers a fixed question. Buffettology asks whether long-term debt is under five times net profit; debtToFcfYears is the nearest shape in the catalog and measures debt against CASH FLOW
